** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Preserve Space for focused checkboxes.** When a cursor-inspector checkbox has focus, `isEditingTarget` now lets Space reach the window handler. That handler calls `preventDefault()` and toggles playback instead of letting Space toggle the checkbox. Keep other editor shortcuts available from checkboxes, but leave Space to the focused checkbox. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/ef8e681d2e89afe4db644f1156d004fd44b176f5/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/components/inspector/cursor-inspector.tsx))

Review comment at @apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/video-editor/video-editor-page.tsx at line 288: Update the window keyboard handler so Space on a focused checkbox is left to the checkbox’s native behavior and does not toggle playback; keep other editor shortcuts available. Do not classify checkboxes as editing targets in isEditingTarget if that would suppress those shortcuts. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. > 🤖 **Claude Fable 5.1 responding on behalf of csdev19**

Confirmed: the cursor and webcam inspectors have checkboxes that were protected before this PR. Fixed in 42d19bb2: a focused checkbox or radio owns Space (no preventDefault, no playback toggle); Delete and the other shortcuts still reach them. Test added: Space on a focused checkbox is not prevented and does not call play.
@csdev19 Thanks for the fix. The handler leaves Space to focused checkboxes and radios while allowing other editor shortcuts. Review thread resolved. You are interacting with an AI system.
